name: B10-0259/2025 (ECR) – Violations of religious freedom in Tibet
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on violations of religious freedom in Tibet
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for action on religious freedom in Tibet. It asks Vietnam and China to explain the death of Tibetan Buddhist leader Hungkar Dorje Rinpoche in Chinese custody. It condemns the abduction of the 11th Panchen Lama 30 years ago and demands news of his fate. It urges China to respect religious and cultural rights in Tibet, asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Chinese officials, and backs Tibetans' right to choose their own religious leaders.

- The Parliament asks the European Union to prepare targeted sanctions on Chinese officials; no one is sanctioned yet.
- It asks China and Vietnam to explain a Tibetan leader's death; the request is not binding.
- It backs Tibetans choosing their own religious leaders; this is a statement of position only.
